## Purpose and analytical scope

This report compares the current U.S. listed-security universe on NASDAQ, NYSE, and AMEX with the current S&P 500 benchmark. It uses two related samples:

1. **Full listed-security universe:** all usable exchange-directory records, including common stocks, ADRs, funds, preferred securities, warrants, rights, units, and other listings. This sample is used in Module 1.
2. **Operating-company equity universe:** securities heuristically classified as common equity or ADRs, reduced to one record per Yahoo-compatible symbol, with valid Yahoo market data, positive market capitalization and price, and populated sector and industry fields. This sample is used in Modules 2 through 4.

The security-type classification is heuristic. Missing fundamental fields are never replaced with fabricated values. The report preserves missing values, reports coverage explicitly, and continues when individual remote requests fail.

Data sources are the NASDAQ exchange screener accessed through `tidyquant::tq_exchange()`, State Street holdings accessed through `tidyquant::tq_index("SP500")`, and Yahoo Finance market data accessed through `quantmod` and `tidyquant`.

## Configuration and setup

```{r}
#| include: true

required_packages <- c(
  "tidyverse",
  "tidyquant",
  "quantmod",
  "dplyr",
  "ggplot2",
  "patchwork",
  "scales",
  "knitr"
)

  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0L) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Install the following required packages before rendering this document: ",
      paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", ")
    ),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(tidyquant)
  library(quantmod)
  library(patchwork)

})

options(

# ---- User-adjustable configuration -----------------------------------------
analysis_date <- Sys.Date()
lookback_calendar_days <- 60L
liquidity_trading_days <- 30L
minimum_valid_trading_days <- 20L
cache_directory <- "data_cache"
refresh_data <- FALSE # FALSE = use cache when available; TRUE = force new downloads
# On the first run, data are downloaded automatically because no cache exists.
# On subsequent runs, FALSE reuses the existing cache.
quote_batch_size <- 150L
price_batch_size <- 50L
max_retry_attempts <- 3L
max_recursive_split_depth <- 2L
retry_base_delay_seconds <- 1
pause_between_batches_seconds <- 0.35

# quantmod's current Yahoo implementation accepts fewer than 100 symbols per
# direct request. The configured quote_batch_size remains the user-facing
# maximum, while this provider cap prevents oversized direct calls.
provider_quote_limit <- 90L

dir.create(cache_directory, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

price_from_date <- analysis_date - lookback_calendar_days
price_to_date <- analysis_date + 1L

# ---- General helpers --------------------------------------------------------
`%||%` <- function(x, y) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0L) y else x
}

snake_names <- function(x) {
  x |>
    stringr::str_replace_all("([a-z0-9])([A-Z])", "\\1_\\2") |>
    stringr::str_replace_all("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_") |>
    stringr::str_replace_all("^_+|_+$", "") |>
    stringr::str_to_lower()
}

clean_text_na <- function(x) {
  y <- as.character(x)
  y <- stringr::str_squish(y)
  missing_tokens <- c("", "NA", "N/A", "NONE", "NULL", "NAN", "--", "-")
  y[stringr::str_to_upper(y) %in% missing_tokens] <- NA_character_
  y
}

safe_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    return(as.numeric(x))
  }

  y <- clean_text_na(x)
  y <- stringr::str_replace_all(y, ",", "")
  y <- stringr::str_replace_all(y, "\\$", "")
  y <- stringr::str_replace_all(y, "%", "")
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(y))
}

positive_or_na <- function(x) {
  y <- safe_numeric(x)
  y[!is.finite(y) | y <= 0] <- NA_real_
  y
}

nonnegative_or_na <- function(x) {
  y <- safe_numeric(x)
  y[!is.finite(y) | y < 0] <- NA_real_
  y
}

ensure_columns <- function(data, columns) {
  missing_columns <- setdiff(columns, names(data))
  for (column in missing_columns) {
    data[[column]] <- rep(NA, nrow(data))
  }
  data
}

first_existing_column <- function(data, candidates, required = TRUE) {
  hit <- intersect(candidates, names(data))
  if (length(hit) > 0L) {
    return(hit[[1]])
  }

  if (required) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "None of the required columns were found: ",
        paste(candidates, collapse = ", ")
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  NULL
}

normalize_yahoo_symbol <- function(x) {
  y <- clean_text_na(x)
  y <- stringr::str_to_upper(y)
  y <- stringr::str_replace_all(y, "\\s+", "")

  # Common preferred-share notations used by U.S. listing directories.
  y <- stringr::str_replace(y, "^([A-Z0-9]+)\\^([A-Z0-9]+)$", "\\1-P\\2")
  y <- stringr::str_replace(y, "^([A-Z0-9]+)[.]PR([A-Z0-9]+)$", "\\1-P\\2")
  y <- stringr::str_replace(y, "^([A-Z0-9]+)-PR([A-Z0-9]+)$", "\\1-P\\2")

  # Yahoo generally uses dashes for class-share separators.
  y <- stringr::str_replace_all(y, "[./]", "-")
  y <- stringr::str_replace_all(y, "\\$", "-P")
  y <- stringr::str_replace_all(y, "[^A-Z0-9=^-]", "")
  y[y == ""] <- NA_character_
  y
}

standardize_sector <- function(x) {
  original <- clean_text_na(x)
  y <- stringr::str_to_lower(original)

  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(y) ~ NA_character_,
    stringr::str_detect(y, "information technology|technology") ~ "Information Technology",
    stringr::str_detect(y, "health care|healthcare|health") ~ "Health Care",
    stringr::str_detect(y, "financial services|financials|finance") ~ "Financials",
    stringr::str_detect(y, "consumer discretionary|consumer cyclical|consumer services") ~ "Consumer Discretionary",
    stringr::str_detect(y, "consumer staples|consumer defensive|consumer non-durables") ~ "Consumer Staples",
    stringr::str_detect(y, "communication services|telecommunication") ~ "Communication Services",
    stringr::str_detect(y, "basic materials|materials") ~ "Materials",
    stringr::str_detect(y, "industrial") ~ "Industrials",
    stringr::str_detect(y, "real estate") ~ "Real Estate",
    stringr::str_detect(y, "utilit") ~ "Utilities",
    stringr::str_detect(y, "energy") ~ "Energy",
    TRUE ~ stringr::str_to_title(original)
  )
}

classify_security_type <- function(company, symbol) {
  company_upper <- stringr::str_to_upper(dplyr::coalesce(clean_text_na(company), ""))
  symbol_upper <- stringr::str_to_upper(dplyr::coalesce(clean_text_na(symbol), ""))

  is_warrant_or_right <-
    stringr::str_detect(company_upper, "\\bWARRANTS?\\b|\\bRIGHTS?\\b") |
    stringr::str_detect(symbol_upper, "[-.](WS|WT|RT)$")

  is_adr <-
    stringr::str_detect(
      company_upper,
      "AMERICAN DEPOSITARY|DEPOSITARY RECEIPT|\\bADR\\b|\\bADS\\b"
    ) &
    !stringr::str_detect(company_upper, "PREFERRED")

  is_preferred <-
    stringr::str_detect(
      company_upper,
      "PREFERRED|PREFERENCE SHARE|DEPOSITARY SHARES.*PREFERRED|\\bPFD\\b"
    ) |
    stringr::str_detect(symbol_upper, "\\^|[-.]P[A-Z0-9]*$")

  is_etf_or_etn <- stringr::str_detect(
    company_upper,
    paste0(
      "\\bETF\\b|\\bETN\\b|EXCHANGE[- ]TRADED|",
      "ISHARES|SPDR|PROSHARES|DIREXION|GLOBAL X|WISDOMTREE|",
      "VANGUARD.*INDEX|INVESCO.*ETF|FIRST TRUST.*ETF"
    )
  )

  is_unit_or_spac <-
    stringr::str_detect(
      company_upper,
      "\\bUNITS?\\b|ACQUISITION CORP|BLANK CHECK|SPECIAL PURPOSE ACQUISITION|\\bSPAC\\b"
    ) |
    (
      stringr::str_detect(symbol_upper, "U$") &
      stringr::str_detect(company_upper, "ACQUISITION|HOLDINGS")
    )

  is_fund <- stringr::str_detect(
    company_upper,
    paste0(
      "CLOSED[- ]END|\\bFUND\\b|PORTFOLIO|MUTUAL FUND|",
      "INCOME TRUST|INVESTMENT TRUST|TERM TRUST"
    )
  )

  is_other_security <- stringr::str_detect(
    company_upper,
    "\\bBONDS?\\b|\\bDEBENTURES?\\b|CERTIFICATES?|STRUCTURED NOTES?"
  )

  dplyr::case_when(
    is_warrant_or_right ~ "Warrant or Right",
    is_adr ~ "ADR",
    is_preferred ~ "Preferred Stock",
    is_etf_or_etn ~ "ETF or ETN",
    is_unit_or_spac ~ "Unit or SPAC",
    is_fund ~ "Closed-End Fund or Other Fund",
    is_other_security ~ "Other or Unclassified",
    TRUE ~ "Common Equity"
  )
}

safe_median <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0L) NA_real_ else stats::median(x)
}

safe_quantile <- function(x, probability) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0L) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  unname(stats::quantile(x, probs = probability, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE))
}

safe_rate <- function(numerator, denominator) {
  if (is.na(denominator) || denominator == 0) NA_real_ else numerator / denominator
}

format_count <- function(x) {
  dplyr::if_else(
    is.na(x),
    "NA",
    scales::number(x, accuracy = 1, big.mark = ",")
  )
}

format_dollar_short <- function(x) {
  dplyr::if_else(
    is.na(x),
    "NA",
    scales::dollar(x, accuracy = 0.1, scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())
  )
}

format_number_short <- function(x) {
  dplyr::if_else(
    is.na(x),
    "NA",
    scales::number(x, accuracy = 0.1, scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())
  )
}

format_percent_1 <- function(x) {
  dplyr::if_else(
    is.na(x),
    "NA",
    scales::percent(x, accuracy = 0.1)
  )
}

show_table <- function(data, caption = NULL, digits = 2) {
  if (!is.data.frame(data) || nrow(data) == 0L) {
    cat("*No observations are available for this table.*\n\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  print(
    knitr::kable(
      data,
      format = "html",
      caption = caption,
      digits = digits,
      escape = TRUE,
      row.names = FALSE
    )
  )
  cat("\n\n")
  invisible(data)
}

empty_plot <- function(title, message, caption = NULL) {
  ggplot() +
    annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = message, size = 4.2) +
    xlim(-1, 1) +
    ylim(-1, 1) +
    labs(title = title, caption = caption) +
    theme_void(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 8.5, color = "grey35", hjust = 0),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 8)
    )
}

split_vector <- function(x, size) {
  if (length(x) == 0L) {
    return(list())
  }
  size <- max(1L, as.integer(size))
  split(x, ceiling(seq_along(x) / size))
}

symbol_signature <- function(symbols) {
  symbols <- sort(unique(stats::na.omit(symbols)))
  temporary_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".txt")
  on.exit(unlink(temporary_file), add = TRUE)
  writeLines(symbols, temporary_file, useBytes = TRUE)
  substr(unname(tools::md5sum(temporary_file)), 1L, 12L)
}

# ---- Condition capture, retries, and caching -------------------------------
capture_call <- function(function_to_run) {
  captured_warnings <- character()

  result <- tryCatch(
    withCallingHandlers(
      function_to_run(),
      warning = function(warning_condition) {
        captured_warnings <<- c(
          captured_warnings,
          conditionMessage(warning_condition)
        )
        invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
      }
    ),
    error = function(error_condition) {
      structure(
        list(message = conditionMessage(error_condition)),
        class = "captured_error"
      )
    }
  )

  if (inherits(result, "captured_error")) {
    return(list(
      ok = FALSE,
      value = NULL,
      warnings = unique(captured_warnings),
      error = result$message
    ))
  }

  list(
    ok = TRUE,
    value = result,
    warnings = unique(captured_warnings),
    error = NA_character_
  )
}

retry_captured <- function(
  function_to_run,
  attempts = max_retry_attempts,
  base_delay_seconds = retry_base_delay_seconds
) {
  attempts <- max(1L, as.integer(attempts))
  all_warnings <- character()
  all_errors <- character()

  for (attempt_number in seq_len(attempts)) {
    attempt <- capture_call(function_to_run)
    all_warnings <- c(all_warnings, attempt$warnings)

    if (isTRUE(attempt$ok)) {
      return(list(
        ok = TRUE,
        value = attempt$value,
        warnings = unique(all_warnings),
        errors = unique(all_errors),
        attempts = attempt_number
      ))
    }

    all_errors <- c(all_errors, attempt$error)

    if (attempt_number < attempts) {
      Sys.sleep(base_delay_seconds * 2^(attempt_number - 1L))
    }
  }

  list(
    ok = FALSE,
    value = NULL,
    warnings = unique(all_warnings),
    errors = unique(all_errors),
    attempts = attempts
  )
}

read_cache_record <- function(path) {
  cached <- readRDS(path)

  if (is.list(cached) && all(c("value", "metadata") %in% names(cached))) {
    return(cached)
  }

  list(
    value = cached,
    metadata = list(
      cached_at = as.POSIXct(file.info(path)$mtime),
      analysis_date = NA_character_,
      cache_stem = tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(path))
    )
  )
}

cache_get <- function(
  cache_stem,
  fetch_function,
  validator = function(x) !is.null(x),
  fallback_prefix = NULL,
  fetch_attempts = max_retry_attempts,
  return_invalid_fetch = FALSE
) {
  exact_path <- file.path(cache_directory, paste0(cache_stem, ".rds"))

  make_metadata_row <- function(
    source,
    path,
    cached_at,
    cache_analysis_date,
    attempts,
    warnings,
    errors
  ) {
    tibble::tibble(
      dataset = cache_stem,
      source = source,
      cache_file = ifelse(is.na(path), NA_character_, basename(path)),
      cache_analysis_date = as.character(cache_analysis_date),
      cached_at = as.character(cached_at),
      attempts = attempts,
      warning_count = length(unique(stats::na.omit(warnings))),
      error_count = length(unique(stats::na.omit(errors)))
    )
  }

  if (!refresh_data && file.exists(exact_path)) {
    cached_attempt <- capture_call(function() read_cache_record(exact_path))

    if (isTRUE(cached_attempt$ok) && validator(cached_attempt$value$value)) {
      record <- cached_attempt$value
      return(list(
        value = record$value,
        meta = make_metadata_row(
          source = "Exact cache",
          path = exact_path,
          cached_at = record$metadata$cached_at %||% file.info(exact_path)$mtime,
          cache_analysis_date = record$metadata$analysis_date %||% NA_character_,
          attempts = 0L,
          warnings = cached_attempt$warnings,
          errors = character()
        )
      ))
    }
  }

  fetched <- retry_captured(fetch_function, attempts = fetch_attempts)

  if (isTRUE(fetched$ok) && validator(fetched$value)) {
    record <- list(
      value = fetched$value,
      metadata = list(
        cached_at = Sys.time(),
        analysis_date = as.character(analysis_date),
        cache_stem = cache_stem
      )
    )

    save_attempt <- capture_call(function() saveRDS(record, exact_path))

    cache_write_succeeded <- isTRUE(save_attempt$ok)

    return(list(
      value = fetched$value,
      meta = make_metadata_row(
        source = if (cache_write_succeeded) {
          "Fresh download"
        } else {
          "Fresh download (cache write failed)"
        },
        path = if (cache_write_succeeded) exact_path else NA_character_,
        cached_at = record$metadata$cached_at,
        cache_analysis_date = record$metadata$analysis_date,
        attempts = fetched$attempts,
        warnings = c(fetched$warnings, save_attempt$warnings),
        errors = c(
          fetched$errors,
          if (cache_write_succeeded) character() else save_attempt$error
        )
      )
    ))
  }

  if (!is.null(fallback_prefix)) {
    fallback_files <- list.files(
      cache_directory,
      full.names = TRUE
    )
    fallback_basenames <- basename(fallback_files)
    fallback_files <- fallback_files[
      startsWith(fallback_basenames, fallback_prefix) &
        stringr::str_detect(fallback_basenames, "[.]rds$")
    ]
    fallback_files <- setdiff(fallback_files, exact_path)

    if (length(fallback_files) > 0L) {
      fallback_files <- fallback_files[
        order(file.info(fallback_files)$mtime, decreasing = TRUE)
      ]

      for (fallback_path in fallback_files) {
        fallback_attempt <- capture_call(function() read_cache_record(fallback_path))

        if (
          isTRUE(fallback_attempt$ok) &&
          validator(fallback_attempt$value$value)
        ) {
          record <- fallback_attempt$value
          return(list(
            value = record$value,
            meta = make_metadata_row(
              source = "Prior cache fallback",
              path = fallback_path,
              cached_at = record$metadata$cached_at %||% file.info(fallback_path)$mtime,
              cache_analysis_date = record$metadata$analysis_date %||% NA_character_,
              attempts = fetched$attempts,
              warnings = c(fetched$warnings, fallback_attempt$warnings),
              errors = fetched$errors
            )
          ))
        }
      }
    }
  }

  if (
    isTRUE(return_invalid_fetch) &&
    isTRUE(fetched$ok) &&
    !is.null(fetched$value)
  ) {
    return(list(
      value = fetched$value,
      meta = make_metadata_row(
        source = "Fresh download (not cached)",
        path = NA_character_,
        cached_at = Sys.time(),
        cache_analysis_date = as.character(analysis_date),
        attempts = fetched$attempts,
        warnings = fetched$warnings,
        errors = fetched$errors
      )
    ))
  }

  list(
    value = NULL,
    meta = make_metadata_row(
      source = "Unavailable",
      path = NA_character_,
      cached_at = NA_character_,
      cache_analysis_date = NA_character_,
      attempts = fetched$attempts,
      warnings = fetched$warnings,
      errors = fetched$errors
    )
  )
}

# ---- Reusable reporting helpers --------------------------------------------
metric_coverage_table <- function(data, metrics, labels = metrics) {
  if (!is.data.frame(data) || nrow(data) == 0L) {
    return(tibble::tibble())
  }

  purrr::map2_dfr(metrics, labels, function(metric, label) {
    values <- data[[metric]]
    valid <- is.finite(values)

    tibble::tibble(
      metric = label,
      initial_observations = nrow(data),
      valid_observations = sum(valid, na.rm = TRUE),
      missing_observations = sum(!valid, na.rm = TRUE),
      missingness_rate = mean(!valid),
      sp500_valid = sum(valid & data$is_sp500, na.rm = TRUE),
      broader_market_valid = sum(valid & !data$is_sp500, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  })
}

make_density_plot <- function(
  data,
  variable,
  title,
  subtitle,
  x_label,
  caption,
  log10_axis = FALSE,
  lower_bound = NULL,
  upper_bound = NULL
) {
  if (!is.data.frame(data) || nrow(data) == 0L || !(variable %in% names(data))) {
    return(empty_plot(title, "No usable observations are available.", caption))
  }

  plot_data <- data |>
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(.data[[variable]]))

  if (!is.null(lower_bound)) {
    plot_data <- plot_data |>
      dplyr::filter(.data[[variable]] >= lower_bound)
  }

  if (!is.null(upper_bound)) {
    plot_data <- plot_data |>
      dplyr::filter(.data[[variable]] <= upper_bound)
  }

  if (isTRUE(log10_axis)) {
    plot_data <- plot_data |>
      dplyr::filter(.data[[variable]] > 0)
  }

  plot_data <- plot_data |>
    dplyr::group_by(benchmark_group) |>
    dplyr::filter(
      dplyr::n() >= 2L,
      dplyr::n_distinct(.data[[variable]]) >= 2L
    ) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

  if (nrow(plot_data) < 2L || dplyr::n_distinct(plot_data[[variable]]) < 2L) {
    return(empty_plot(title, "Too few distinct observations are available for a density estimate.", caption))
  }

  plot <- ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = .data[[variable]],
      color = benchmark_group,
      fill = benchmark_group
    )
  ) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.28, linewidth = 0.9, adjust = 1.05, na.rm = TRUE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = benchmark_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = benchmark_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = x_label,
      y = "Density",
      caption = caption
    )

  if (isTRUE(log10_axis)) {
    plot <- plot +
      scale_x_log10(
        labels = scales::label_dollar(
          accuracy = 1,
          scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale()
        )
      )
  }

  plot
}

)
```

```{r}
  ),

  )
)
```

## Data acquisition and construction of the master universe

### Exchange directories and S&P 500 membership

```{r}
#| label: acquire-directories-and-index

standardize_exchange_download <- function(data, exchange_name) {
  if (!is.data.frame(data) || nrow(data) == 0L) {
    stop(paste0("No records were returned for ", exchange_name, "."), call. = FALSE)
  }

  names(data) <- snake_names(names(data))
  data <- ensure_columns(
    data,
    c(
      "symbol",
      "company",
      "last_sale_price",
      "market_cap",
      "country",
      "ipo_year",
      "sector",
      "industry"
    )
  )

  data |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      symbol_original = clean_text_na(symbol),
      company = clean_text_na(company),
      exchange = stringr::str_to_upper(exchange_name),
      last_sale_price_exchange = positive_or_na(last_sale_price),
      market_cap_exchange = positive_or_na(market_cap),
      country = clean_text_na(country),
      ipo_year = suppressWarnings(as.integer(ipo_year)),
      sector_raw = clean_text_na(sector),
      industry_raw = clean_text_na(industry)
    )
}

fetch_exchange_one <- function(exchange_name) {
  downloaded <- tidyquant::tq_exchange(exchange_name)

  if (!is.data.frame(downloaded) || nrow(downloaded) == 0L) {
    stop(
      paste0("tidyquant::tq_exchange() returned no usable records for ", exchange_name, "."),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  standardize_exchange_download(downloaded, exchange_name)
}

standardize_sp500_download <- function(data, retrieval_mode) {
  if (!is.data.frame(data) || nrow(data) == 0L) {
    stop("No S&P 500 constituent records were returned.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  names(data) <- snake_names(names(data))

  symbol_column <- first_existing_column(data, c("symbol", "ticker"))
  company_column <- first_existing_column(data, c("company", "name"), required = FALSE)
  weight_column <- first_existing_column(
    data,
    c("weight", "weight_percent", "portfolio_weight"),
    required = FALSE
  )
  sector_column <- first_existing_column(
    data,
    c("sector", "gics_sector"),
    required = FALSE
  )

  output <- tibble::tibble(
    sp500_symbol_original = clean_text_na(data[[symbol_column]]),
    sp500_company = if (is.null(company_column)) {
      rep(NA_character_, nrow(data))
    } else {
      clean_text_na(data[[company_column]])
    },
    sp500_weight_raw = if (is.null(weight_column)) {
      rep(NA_real_, nrow(data))
    } else {
      safe_numeric(data[[weight_column]])
    },
    sp500_sector_raw = if (is.null(sector_column)) {
      rep(NA_character_, nrow(data))
    } else {
      clean_text_na(data[[sector_column]])
    },
    sp500_retrieval_mode = retrieval_mode
  ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      symbol_yahoo = normalize_yahoo_symbol(sp500_symbol_original),
      sp500_sector_clean = standardize_sector(sp500_sector_raw)
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(symbol_yahoo)) |>
    dplyr::distinct(symbol_yahoo, .keep_all = TRUE)

  positive_weight_total <- sum(
    output$sp500_weight_raw[
      is.finite(output$sp500_weight_raw) & output$sp500_weight_raw > 0
    ],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  output |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      sp500_weight = dplyr::if_else(
        is.finite(sp500_weight_raw) &
          sp500_weight_raw > 0 &
          positive_weight_total > 0,
        sp500_weight_raw / positive_weight_total,
        NA_real_
      ),
      sp500_member = TRUE
    )
}

fetch_sp500 <- function() {
  tq_index_formals <- names(formals(tidyquant::tq_index))
  supports_explicit_fallback <- "use_fallback" %in% tq_index_formals

  live_attempt <- capture_call(function() {
    if (supports_explicit_fallback) {
      tidyquant::tq_index("SP500", use_fallback = FALSE)
    } else {
      tidyquant::tq_index("SP500")
    }
  })

  if (
    isTRUE(live_attempt$ok) &&
    is.data.frame(live_attempt$value) &&
    nrow(live_attempt$value) > 0L
  ) {
    retrieval_mode <- if (supports_explicit_fallback) {
      "Live SSGA holdings"
    } else {
      "tidyquant default retrieval"
    }

    return(standardize_sp500_download(live_attempt$value, retrieval_mode))
  }

  if (!supports_explicit_fallback) {
    stop(
      "The S&P 500 constituent table could not be retrieved by tidyquant::tq_index().",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  packaged_fallback <- tidyquant::tq_index("SP500", use_fallback = TRUE)

  if (!is.data.frame(packaged_fallback) || nrow(packaged_fallback) == 0L) {
    stop(
      "Both the live S&P 500 retrieval and tidyquant's packaged fallback were unavailable.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  standardize_sp500_download(
    packaged_fallback,
    "tidyquant packaged fallback"
  )
}

exchange_names <- c("NASDAQ", "NYSE", "AMEX")

exchange_results <- purrr::set_names(exchange_names) |>
  purrr::map(function(exchange_name) {
    cache_get(
      cache_stem = paste0(
        "exchange_",
        stringr::str_to_lower(exchange_name),
        "_",
        analysis_date
      ),
      fetch_function = function() fetch_exchange_one(exchange_name),
      validator = function(x) {
        required_exchange_columns <- c(
          "symbol_original",
          "company",
          "exchange",
          "last_sale_price_exchange",
          "market_cap_exchange",
          "sector_raw",
          "industry_raw"
        )

        is.data.frame(x) &&
          nrow(x) > 0L &&
          all(required_exchange_columns %in% names(x))
      },
      fallback_prefix = paste0(
        "exchange_",
        stringr::str_to_lower(exchange_name),
        "_"
      )
    )
  })

available_exchange_data <- exchange_results |>
  purrr::map("value") |>
  purrr::keep(~ is.data.frame(.x) && nrow(.x) > 0L)

if (length(available_exchange_data) == 0L) {
  stop(
    "No exchange directory could be retrieved and no usable exchange cache was found.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

sp500_result <- cache_get(
  cache_stem = paste0("sp500_constituents_", analysis_date),
  fetch_function = fetch_sp500,
  validator = function(x) {
    required_sp500_columns <- c(
      "sp500_symbol_original",
      "symbol_yahoo",
      "sp500_company",
      "sp500_weight",
      "sp500_sector_clean",
      "sp500_retrieval_mode"
    )

    is.data.frame(x) &&
      nrow(x) > 0L &&
      all(required_sp500_columns %in% names(x))
  },
  fallback_prefix = "sp500_constituents_"
)

if (!is.data.frame(sp500_result$value) || nrow(sp500_result$value) == 0L) {
  stop(
    "The S&P 500 constituent table is unavailable and no usable cache was found.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

exchange_cache_manifest <- exchange_results |>
  purrr::map_dfr("meta")

cache_manifest <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  exchange_cache_manifest,
  sp500_result$meta
)

exchange_download_status <- tibble::tibble(
  exchange = exchange_names,
  records = purrr::map_int(
    exchange_results,
    function(result) {
      if (is.data.frame(result$value)) nrow(result$value) else 0L
    }
  ),
  source = purrr::map_chr(exchange_results, ~ .x$meta$source[[1]])
)

sp500_df <- sp500_result$value
raw_universe_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(available_exchange_data)
```

### Cleaning, symbol normalization, and membership matching

```{r}
#| label: clean-master-universe

raw_universe_count <- nrow(raw_universe_df)

invalid_entry_log <- raw_universe_df |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    invalid_symbol = is.na(symbol_original),
    invalid_company = is.na(company)
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    starting_records = dplyr::n(),
    missing_symbol = sum(invalid_symbol),
    missing_company = sum(invalid_company),
    removed_invalid_records = sum(invalid_symbol | invalid_company)
  )

universe_clean_stage_1 <- raw_universe_df |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(symbol_original), !is.na(company)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    symbol_original = stringr::str_to_upper(symbol_original),
    symbol_yahoo = normalize_yahoo_symbol(symbol_original),
    company = clean_text_na(company),
    sector_raw = clean_text_na(sector_raw),
    industry_raw = clean_text_na(industry_raw),
    country = clean_text_na(country),
    market_cap_exchange = positive_or_na(market_cap_exchange),
    last_sale_price_exchange = positive_or_na(last_sale_price_exchange)
  )

exact_duplicate_count <- nrow(universe_clean_stage_1) -
  nrow(dplyr::distinct(universe_clean_stage_1))

universe_clean_stage_2 <- universe_clean_stage_1 |>
  dplyr::distinct()

same_listing_duplicate_table <- universe_clean_stage_2 |>
  dplyr::count(exchange, symbol_original, name = "record_count") |>
  dplyr::filter(record_count > 1L) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(record_count), exchange, symbol_original)

same_listing_duplicate_count <- sum(
  pmax(same_listing_duplicate_table$record_count - 1L, 0L)
)

universe_clean_stage_3 <- universe_clean_stage_2 |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    completeness_score =
      as.integer(!is.na(company)) +
      as.integer(!is.na(market_cap_exchange)) +
      as.integer(!is.na(last_sale_price_exchange)) +
      as.integer(!is.na(sector_raw)) +
      as.integer(!is.na(industry_raw)) +
      as.integer(!is.na(country))
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(exchange, symbol_original) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(completeness_score), .by_group = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 1L) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(-completeness_score)

universe_df <- universe_clean_stage_3 |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    security_type = classify_security_type(company, symbol_original),
    sector_exchange_clean = standardize_sector(sector_raw),
    industry_clean = clean_text_na(industry_raw)
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    sp500_df |>
      dplyr::select(
        symbol_yahoo,
        sp500_symbol_original,
        sp500_company,
        sp500_weight,
        sp500_sector_raw,
        sp500_sector_clean,
        sp500_member
      ),
    by = "symbol_yahoo"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    is_sp500 = tidyr::replace_na(sp500_member, FALSE),
    benchmark_group = factor(
      dplyr::if_else(is_sp500, "S&P 500", "Broader Market"),
      levels = benchmark_levels
    ),
    sector_clean = dplyr::coalesce(
      sector_exchange_clean,
      sp500_sector_clean
    ),
    sector_display = dplyr::coalesce(sector_clean, "Unclassified"),
    industry_display = dplyr::coalesce(industry_clean, "Unclassified"),
    symbol_was_normalized =
      !is.na(symbol_yahoo) & symbol_original != symbol_yahoo
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(-sp500_member)

yahoo_symbol_duplicate_table <- universe_df |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(symbol_yahoo)) |>
  dplyr::count(symbol_yahoo, name = "listing_records") |>
  dplyr::filter(listing_records > 1L) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(listing_records), symbol_yahoo)

sp500_universe_match <- sp500_df |>
  dplyr::anti_join(
    universe_df |>
      dplyr::distinct(symbol_yahoo),
    by = "symbol_yahoo"
  )

symbol_normalization_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  measure = c(
    "Raw exchange records",
```


The symbol-normalization rules preserve `symbol_original` and create a separate `symbol_yahoo`. Periods and slashes used for share classes are converted to dashes, and common preferred-share notations are translated to Yahoo-compatible forms. The master table retains exchange records; unmatched S&P 500 constituents are added only to the downstream download-candidate table so benchmark download coverage can be diagnosed without altering Module 1 listing counts.

### Snapshot quote data

```{r}
#| label: quote-retrieval-functions

quote_fields <- c(
  "regularMarketPrice",
  "marketCap",
  "trailingPE",
  "priceToBook",
  "averageDailyVolume3Month",
  "averageDailyVolume10Day"
)

empty_condition_log <- function() {
  tibble::tibble(
    stage = character(),
    batch_id = character(),
    symbol_yahoo = character(),
    status = character(),
    message = character()
  )
}

empty_quote_rows <- function(symbols) {
  tibble::tibble(
    symbol_yahoo = symbols,
    quote_trade_time = NA_character_,
    quote_price = NA_real_,
    market_cap_quote = NA_real_,
    trailing_pe = NA_real_,
    price_to_book = NA_real_,
    average_daily_volume_3m_quote = NA_real_,
    average_daily_volume_10d_quote = NA_real_,
    quote_success = FALSE
  )
}

fetch_quote_batch_once <- function(symbols) {
  raw_quotes <- quantmod::getQuote(
    Symbols = symbols,
    src = "yahoo",
    what = quote_fields
  )

  if (!is.data.frame(raw_quotes) || nrow(raw_quotes) == 0L) {
    stop("Yahoo returned no quote rows for this batch.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  quote_data <- raw_quotes |>
    as.data.frame(stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE) |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("symbol_yahoo")

  names(quote_data) <- snake_names(names(quote_data))
  quote_data <- ensure_columns(
    quote_data,
    c(
      "symbol_yahoo",
      "regular_market_time",
      "regular_market_price",
      "market_cap",
      "trailing_pe",
      "price_to_book",
      "average_daily_volume3_month",
      "average_daily_volume10_day"
    )
  )

  quote_data <- quote_data |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      symbol_yahoo = normalize_yahoo_symbol(symbol_yahoo),
      quote_trade_time = as.character(regular_market_time),
      quote_price = positive_or_na(regular_market_price),
      market_cap_quote = positive_or_na(market_cap),
      trailing_pe = safe_numeric(trailing_pe),
      price_to_book = safe_numeric(price_to_book),
      average_daily_volume_3m_quote = positive_or_na(average_daily_volume3_month),
      average_daily_volume_10d_quote = positive_or_na(average_daily_volume10_day)
    ) |>
    dplyr::distinct(symbol_yahoo, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      quote_success = dplyr::if_any(
        c(
          quote_price,
          market_cap_quote,
          trailing_pe,
          price_to_book,
          average_daily_volume_3m_quote,
          average_daily_volume_10d_quote
        ),
        ~ is.finite(.x)
      )
    )

  tibble::tibble(symbol_yahoo = symbols) |>
    dplyr::left_join(quote_data, by = "symbol_yahoo") |>
    dplyr::mutate(quote_success = tidyr::replace_na(quote_success, FALSE))
}

condition_log_rows <- function(attempt, stage, batch_id, symbols) {
  warning_rows <- if (length(attempt$warnings) > 0L) {
    tibble::tibble(
      stage = stage,
      batch_id = batch_id,
      symbol_yahoo = NA_character_,
      status = "warning",
      message = attempt$warnings
    )
  } else {
    tibble::tibble()
  }

  error_rows <- if (length(attempt$errors) > 0L) {
    tibble::tibble(
      stage = stage,
      batch_id = batch_id,
      symbol_yahoo = if (length(symbols) == 1L) symbols else NA_character_,
      status = "error",
      message = attempt$errors
    )
  } else {
    tibble::tibble()
  }

  dplyr::bind_rows(warning_rows, error_rows)
}

is_global_download_error <- function(messages) {
  messages <- unique(stats::na.omit(messages))
  if (length(messages) == 0L) {
    return(FALSE)
  }

  message_text <- stringr::str_to_lower(paste(messages, collapse = " | "))

  stringr::str_detect(
    message_text,
    paste0(
      "crumb|consent|could not resolve|failed to connect|connection refused|",
      "cannot open.*url|cannot open the connection|download failed|",
      "timed out|timeout|ssl|rate limit|too many requests|",
      "http[^0-9]*(401|403|429|500|502|503|504)|service unavailable"
    )
  )
}

fetch_quote_resilient <- function(symbols, batch_id, depth = 0L) {
  attempt <- retry_captured(
    function() fetch_quote_batch_once(symbols),
    attempts = max_retry_attempts
  )

  attempt_log <- condition_log_rows(
    attempt,
    stage = "snapshot_quote",
    batch_id = batch_id,
    symbols = symbols
  )

  if (isTRUE(attempt$ok)) {
    quote_data <- attempt$value
    global_failure <-
      !any(quote_data$quote_success, na.rm = TRUE) &&
      is_global_download_error(attempt$warnings)

    no_data_log <- quote_data |>
      dplyr::filter(!quote_success) |>
      dplyr::transmute(
        stage = "snapshot_quote",
        batch_id = batch_id,
        symbol_yahoo = symbol_yahoo,
        status = dplyr::if_else(
          global_failure,
          "global_failure",
          "no_data"
        ),
        message = dplyr::if_else(
          global_failure,
          "The provider returned no usable quote data and emitted a global connection or authorization warning.",
          "No requested quote field was returned."
        )
      )

    return(list(
      data = quote_data,
      log = dplyr::bind_rows(attempt_log, no_data_log),
      global_failure = global_failure
    ))
  }

  global_failure <- is_global_download_error(c(attempt$errors, attempt$warnings))
  may_split <-
    !global_failure &&
    length(symbols) > 1L &&
    depth < max_recursive_split_depth

  if (may_split) {
    split_point <- ceiling(length(symbols) / 2L)
    left_symbols <- symbols[seq_len(split_point)]
    right_symbols <- symbols[-seq_len(split_point)]

    left_result <- fetch_quote_resilient(
      left_symbols,
      paste0(batch_id, "L"),
      depth = depth + 1L
    )
    right_result <- fetch_quote_resilient(
      right_symbols,
      paste0(batch_id, "R"),
      depth = depth + 1L
    )

    return(list(
      data = dplyr::bind_rows(left_result$data, right_result$data),
      log = dplyr::bind_rows(
        attempt_log,
        left_result$log,
        right_result$log
      ),
      global_failure = isTRUE(left_result$global_failure) &&
        isTRUE(right_result$global_failure)
    ))
  }

  failure_message <- paste(
    unique(c(attempt$errors, attempt$warnings)),
    collapse = " | "
  )
  if (identical(failure_message, "")) {
    failure_message <- "The quote batch failed without an error message."
  }

  list(
    data = empty_quote_rows(symbols),
    log = dplyr::bind_rows(
      attempt_log,
      tibble::tibble(
        stage = "snapshot_quote",
        batch_id = batch_id,
        symbol_yahoo = symbols,
        status = if (global_failure) "global_failure" else "failed_batch",
        message = failure_message
      )
    ),
    global_failure = global_failure
  )
}

fetch_all_quotes <- function(symbols) {
  effective_batch_size <- min(
    as.integer(quote_batch_size),
    as.integer(provider_quote_limit)
  )
  batches <- split_vector(symbols, effective_batch_size)
  results <- vector("list", length(batches))

  if (length(batches) == 0L) {
    return(list(
      data = empty_quote_rows(character()),
      log = empty_condition_log(),
      requested_symbols = symbols,
      effective_batch_size = effective_batch_size,
      fetched_at = Sys.time()
    ))
  }

  for (batch_number in seq_along(batches)) {
    message(
      "Retrieving quote batch ",
      batch_number,
      " of ",
      length(batches),
      "."
    )

    results[[batch_number]] <- fetch_quote_resilient(
      batches[[batch_number]],
      sprintf("Q%04d", batch_number)
    )

    if (isTRUE(results[[batch_number]]$global_failure)) {
      remaining_batches <- if (batch_number < length(batches)) {
        seq.int(batch_number + 1L, length(batches))
      } else {
        integer()
      }

      for (remaining_number in remaining_batches) {
        skipped_symbols <- batches[[remaining_number]]
        results[[remaining_number]] <- list(
          data = empty_quote_rows(skipped_symbols),
          log = tibble::tibble(
            stage = "snapshot_quote",
            batch_id = sprintf("Q%04d", remaining_number),
            symbol_yahoo = skipped_symbols,
            status = "skipped_after_global_failure",
            message = "Skipped after a provider-wide quote failure was detected."
          ),
          global_failure = TRUE
        )
      }
      break
    }

    if (batch_number < length(batches)) {
      Sys.sleep(pause_between_batches_seconds)
    }
  }

  quote_data <- purrr::map_dfr(results, "data") |>
    dplyr::arrange(symbol_yahoo) |>
    dplyr::distinct(symbol_yahoo, .keep_all = TRUE)

  quote_data <- tibble::tibble(symbol_yahoo = symbols) |>
    dplyr::left_join(quote_data, by = "symbol_yahoo") |>
    dplyr::mutate(quote_success = tidyr::replace_na(quote_success, FALSE))

  list(
    data = quote_data,
    log = purrr::map_dfr(results, "log"),
    requested_symbols = symbols,
    effective_batch_size = effective_batch_size,
    fetched_at = Sys.time()
  )
}

quote_cache <- cache_get(
  cache_stem = paste0(
    "quote_snapshot_",
    analysis_date,
    "_",
    download_symbol_hash
  ),
  fetch_function = function() fetch_all_quotes(download_symbols),
  validator = function(x) {
    required_quote_columns <- c(
      "symbol_yahoo",
      "quote_trade_time",
      "quote_price",
      "market_cap_quote",
      "trailing_pe",
      "price_to_book",
      "average_daily_volume_3m_quote",
      "average_daily_volume_10d_quote",
      "quote_success"
    )

    is.list(x) &&
      all(
        c("data", "log", "requested_symbols", "effective_batch_size") %in%
          names(x)
      ) &&
      is.data.frame(x$data) &&
      is.data.frame(x$log) &&
      all(required_quote_columns %in% names(x$data)) &&
      (
        length(x$requested_symbols) == 0L ||
          any(x$data$quote_success, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
  },
  fallback_prefix = NULL,
  fetch_attempts = 1L,
  return_invalid_fetch = TRUE
)

if (is.null(quote_cache$value)) {
  quote_fetch_result <- list(
    data = empty_quote_rows(download_symbols),
    log = tibble::tibble(
      stage = "snapshot_quote",
      batch_id = NA_character_,
      symbol_yahoo = download_symbols,
      status = "failed_symbol",
      message = "The quote retrieval workflow returned no result."
    ),
    requested_symbols = download_symbols,
    effective_batch_size = min(quote_batch_size, provider_quote_limit),
    fetched_at = Sys.time()
  )
} else {
  quote_fetch_result <- quote_cache$value
}

quote_df <- quote_fetch_result$data
quote_log <- dplyr::bind_rows(empty_condition_log(), quote_fetch_result$log)

quote_retrieval_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  measure = c(
    "Requested symbols",
    "Symbols with at least one requested quote field",
    "Symbols with no requested quote field",
    "Quote success rate",
    "Quote log rows",
    "Effective quote batch size"
  ),
  value = c(
    length(download_symbols),
    sum(quote_df$quote_success, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(!quote_df$quote_success, na.rm = TRUE),
    safe_rate(sum(quote_df$quote_success, na.rm = TRUE), length(download_symbols)),
    nrow(quote_log),
    quote_fetch_result$effective_batch_size
  ),
  display_value = c(
    format_count(length(download_symbols)),
    format_count(sum(quote_df$quote_success, na.rm = TRUE)),
    format_count(sum(!quote_df$quote_success, na.rm = TRUE)),
    format_percent_1(
      safe_rate(sum(quote_df$quote_success, na.rm = TRUE), length(download_symbols))
    ),
    format_count(nrow(quote_log)),
    format_count(quote_fetch_result$effective_batch_size)
  )
)
```

### Historical prices and 30-day liquidity

```{r}
#| label: price-retrieval-functions

empty_price_data <- function() {
  tibble::tibble(
    symbol_yahoo = character(),
    date = as.Date(character()),
    open = numeric(),
    high = numeric(),
    low = numeric(),
    close = numeric(),
    volume = numeric(),
    adjusted = numeric()
  )
}

fetch_price_batch_once <- function(symbols) {
  raw_prices <- tidyquant::tq_get(
    x = symbols,
    get = "stock.prices",
    from = price_from_date,
    to = price_to_date,
    complete_cases = FALSE
  )

  if (!is.data.frame(raw_prices)) {
    stop("Yahoo returned an invalid historical-price object.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  names(raw_prices) <- snake_names(names(raw_prices))

  if (!("symbol" %in% names(raw_prices))) {
    if (length(symbols) == 1L && nrow(raw_prices) > 0L) {
      raw_prices$symbol <- symbols[[1]]
    } else if (nrow(raw_prices) > 0L) {
      stop(
        "Historical prices for a multi-symbol batch did not include a symbol column.",
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
  }

  raw_prices <- ensure_columns(
    raw_prices,
    c("symbol", "date", "open", "high", "low", "close", "volume", "adjusted")
  )

  raw_prices |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      symbol_yahoo = normalize_yahoo_symbol(symbol),
      date = as.Date(date),
      open = safe_numeric(open),
      high = safe_numeric(high),
      low = safe_numeric(low),
      close = safe_numeric(close),
      volume = safe_numeric(volume),
      adjusted = safe_numeric(adjusted)
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(symbol_yahoo), !is.na(date)) |>
    dplyr::distinct(symbol_yahoo, date, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

fetch_price_resilient <- function(symbols, batch_id, depth = 0L) {
  attempt <- retry_captured(
    function() fetch_price_batch_once(symbols),
    attempts = max_retry_attempts
  )

  attempt_log <- condition_log_rows(
    attempt,
    stage = "historical_price",
    batch_id = batch_id,
    symbols = symbols
  )

  if (isTRUE(attempt$ok)) {
    price_data <- attempt$value
    successful_symbols <- price_data |>
      dplyr::filter(
        !is.na(date),
        is.finite(close),
        close > 0,
        is.finite(volume),
        volume >= 0
      ) |>
      dplyr::distinct(symbol_yahoo) |>
      dplyr::pull(symbol_yahoo)

    missing_symbols <- setdiff(symbols, successful_symbols)
    global_failure <-
      length(successful_symbols) == 0L &&
      is_global_download_error(attempt$warnings)

    no_data_log <- if (length(missing_symbols) > 0L) {
      tibble::tibble(
        stage = "historical_price",
        batch_id = batch_id,
        symbol_yahoo = missing_symbols,
        status = if (global_failure) "global_failure" else "no_data",
        message = if (global_failure) {
          "The provider returned no usable price data and emitted a global connection or authorization warning."
        } else {
          "No valid close-and-volume observation was returned."
        }
      )
    } else {
      tibble::tibble()
    }

    return(list(
      data = price_data,
      log = dplyr::bind_rows(attempt_log, no_data_log),
      global_failure = global_failure
    ))
  }

  global_failure <- is_global_download_error(c(attempt$errors, attempt$warnings))
  may_split <-
    !global_failure &&
    length(symbols) > 1L &&
    depth < max_recursive_split_depth

  if (may_split) {
    split_point <- ceiling(length(symbols) / 2L)
    left_symbols <- symbols[seq_len(split_point)]
    right_symbols <- symbols[-seq_len(split_point)]

    left_result <- fetch_price_resilient(
      left_symbols,
      paste0(batch_id, "L"),
      depth = depth + 1L
    )
    right_result <- fetch_price_resilient(
      right_symbols,
      paste0(batch_id, "R"),
      depth = depth + 1L
    )

    return(list(
      data = dplyr::bind_rows(left_result$data, right_result$data),
      log = dplyr::bind_rows(
        attempt_log,
        left_result$log,
        right_result$log
      ),
      global_failure = isTRUE(left_result$global_failure) &&
        isTRUE(right_result$global_failure)
    ))
  }

  failure_message <- paste(
    unique(c(attempt$errors, attempt$warnings)),
    collapse = " | "
  )
  if (identical(failure_message, "")) {
    failure_message <- "The historical-price batch failed without an error message."
  }

  list(
    data = empty_price_data(),
    log = dplyr::bind_rows(
      attempt_log,
      tibble::tibble(
        stage = "historical_price",
        batch_id = batch_id,
        symbol_yahoo = symbols,
        status = if (global_failure) "global_failure" else "failed_batch",
        message = failure_message
      )
    ),
    global_failure = global_failure
  )
}

fetch_all_prices <- function(symbols) {
  batches <- split_vector(symbols, price_batch_size)
  results <- vector("list", length(batches))

  if (length(batches) == 0L) {
    return(list(
      data = empty_price_data(),
      log = empty_condition_log(),
      requested_symbols = symbols,
      effective_batch_size = price_batch_size,
      from = price_from_date,
      to = price_to_date,
      fetched_at = Sys.time()
    ))
  }

  for (batch_number in seq_along(batches)) {
    message(
      "Retrieving historical-price batch ",
      batch_number,
      " of ",
      length(batches),
      "."
    )

    results[[batch_number]] <- fetch_price_resilient(
      batches[[batch_number]],
      sprintf("P%04d", batch_number)
    )

    if (isTRUE(results[[batch_number]]$global_failure)) {
      remaining_batches <- if (batch_number < length(batches)) {
        seq.int(batch_number + 1L, length(batches))
      } else {
        integer()
      }

      for (remaining_number in remaining_batches) {
        skipped_symbols <- batches[[remaining_number]]
        results[[remaining_number]] <- list(
          data = empty_price_data(),
          log = tibble::tibble(
            stage = "historical_price",
            batch_id = sprintf("P%04d", remaining_number),
            symbol_yahoo = skipped_symbols,
            status = "skipped_after_global_failure",
            message = "Skipped after a provider-wide historical-price failure was detected."
          ),
          global_failure = TRUE
        )
      }
      break
    }

    if (batch_number < length(batches)) {
      Sys.sleep(pause_between_batches_seconds)
    }
  }

  price_data <- purrr::map_dfr(results, "data") |>
    dplyr::distinct(symbol_yahoo, date, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
    dplyr::arrange(symbol_yahoo, date)

  list(
    data = price_data,
    log = purrr::map_dfr(results, "log"),
    requested_symbols = symbols,
    effective_batch_size = price_batch_size,
    from = price_from_date,
    to = price_to_date,
    fetched_at = Sys.time()
  )
}

price_cache <- cache_get(
  cache_stem = paste0(
    "price_history_",
    price_from_date,
    "_",
    analysis_date,
    "_",
    download_symbol_hash
  ),
  fetch_function = function() fetch_all_prices(download_symbols),
  validator = function(x) {
    required_price_columns <- c(
      "symbol_yahoo",
      "date",
      "open",
      "high",
      "low",
      "close",
      "volume",
      "adjusted"
    )

    is.list(x) &&
      all(c("data", "log", "requested_symbols") %in% names(x)) &&
      is.data.frame(x$data) &&
      is.data.frame(x$log) &&
      all(required_price_columns %in% names(x$data)) &&
      (
        length(x$requested_symbols) == 0L ||
          any(
            is.finite(x$data$close) &
              x$data$close > 0 &
              is.finite(x$data$volume) &
              x$data$volume >= 0,
            na.rm = TRUE
          )
      )
  },
  fallback_prefix = NULL,
  fetch_attempts = 1L,
  return_invalid_fetch = TRUE
)

if (is.null(price_cache$value)) {
  price_fetch_result <- list(
    data = empty_price_data(),
    log = tibble::tibble(
      stage = "historical_price",
      batch_id = NA_character_,
      symbol_yahoo = download_symbols,

    requested_symbols = download_symbols,
    effective_batch_size = price_batch_size,
    from = price_from_date,
    to = price_to_date,
    fetched_at = Sys.time()
  )
} else {

}

price_history_df <- price_fetch_result$data
price_log <- dplyr::bind_rows(empty_condition_log(), price_fetch_result$log)

valid_price_history_df <- price_history_df |>
  dplyr::filter(
    date <= analysis_date,
    is.finite(close),
    close > 0,
    is.finite(volume),
    volume >= 0
  ) |>
  dplyr::distinct(symbol_yahoo, date, .keep_all = TRUE)

liquidity_df <- valid_price_history_df |>
  dplyr::group_by(symbol_yahoo) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(date), .by_group = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = liquidity_trading_days) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    valid_trading_days = dplyr::n(),
    latest_history_date = dplyr::first(date),
    earliest_history_date_used = dplyr::last(date),
    latest_close = dplyr::first(close),
    avg_daily_share_volume_raw = mean(volume, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_daily_dollar_volume_raw = mean(close * volume, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    historical_data_available = valid_trading_days > 0L,
    liquidity_history_adequate =
      valid_trading_days >= minimum_valid_trading_days,
    avg_daily_share_volume_30d = dplyr::if_else(
      liquidity_history_adequate,
      avg_daily_share_volume_raw,
      NA_real_
    ),
    avg_daily_dollar_volume_30d = dplyr::if_else(
      liquidity_history_adequate,
      avg_daily_dollar_volume_raw,
      NA_real_
    )
  )

price_symbol_coverage <- tibble::tibble(symbol_yahoo = download_symbols) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    liquidity_df |>
      dplyr::select(
        symbol_yahoo,
        valid_trading_days,
        historical_data_available,
        liquidity_history_adequate
      ),
    by = "symbol_yahoo"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    valid_trading_days = tidyr::replace_na(valid_trading_days, 0L),
    historical_data_available =
      tidyr::replace_na(historical_data_available, FALSE),
    liquidity_history_adequate =
      tidyr::replace_na(liquidity_history_adequate, FALSE)
  )

price_retrieval_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  measure = c(
    "Requested symbols",
    "Symbols with at least one valid close-and-volume observation",
    "Symbols with adequate liquidity history",
    "Symbols with insufficient or unavailable liquidity history",
    "Historical-price success rate",
    "Median valid trading observations among retrieved symbols",
    "Historical-price log rows"
  ),
  value = c(

    sum(price_symbol_coverage$liquidity_history_adequate),
    sum(!price_symbol_coverage$liquidity_history_adequate),

      sum(price_symbol_coverage$historical_data_available),

    ),
    safe_median(
      price_symbol_coverage$valid_trading_days[
        price_symbol_coverage$historical_data_available
      ]
    ),
    nrow(price_log)
  ),
  display_value = c(
    format_count(length(download_symbols)),
    format_count(sum(price_symbol_coverage$historical_data_available)),
    format_count(sum(price_symbol_coverage$liquidity_history_adequate)),
    format_count(sum(!price_symbol_coverage$liquidity_history_adequate)),
    format_percent_1(
      safe_rate(
        sum(price_symbol_coverage$historical_data_available),
        length(download_symbols)
      )
    ),
    format_count(
      safe_median(
        price_symbol_coverage$valid_trading_days[
          price_symbol_coverage$historical_data_available
        ]
      )
    ),
    format_count(nrow(price_log))
  )
)
```

### Final operating-company equity universe

```{r}
#| label: build-final-equity-universe

analysis_enriched_df <- equity_candidates_df |>
  dplyr::left_join(quote_df, by = "symbol_yahoo") |>
  dplyr::left_join(liquidity_df, by = "symbol_yahoo") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    quote_success = tidyr::replace_na(quote_success, FALSE),
    historical_data_available =
      tidyr::replace_na(historical_data_available, FALSE),
    liquidity_history_adequate =
      tidyr::replace_na(liquidity_history_adequate, FALSE),
    valid_yahoo_data = quote_success | historical_data_available,
    market_cap = dplyr::case_when(
      is.finite(market_cap_exchange) & market_cap_exchange > 0 ~
        market_cap_exchange,
      is.finite(market_cap_quote) & market_cap_quote > 0 ~
        market_cap_quote,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    market_cap_source = dplyr::case_when(
      is.finite(market_cap_exchange) & market_cap_exchange > 0 ~
        "Exchange directory",
      is.finite(market_cap_quote) & market_cap_quote > 0 ~
        "Yahoo quote fallback",
      TRUE ~ "Unavailable"
    ),
    reference_price = dplyr::case_when(
      is.finite(quote_price) & quote_price > 0 ~ quote_price,
      is.finite(latest_close) & latest_close > 0 ~ latest_close,
      is.finite(last_sale_price_exchange) & last_sale_price_exchange > 0 ~
        last_sale_price_exchange,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    price_source = dplyr::case_when(
      is.finite(quote_price) & quote_price > 0 ~ "Yahoo snapshot quote",
      is.finite(latest_close) & latest_close > 0 ~ "Yahoo historical close",
      is.finite(last_sale_price_exchange) & last_sale_price_exchange > 0 ~
        "Exchange directory",
      TRUE ~ "Unavailable"
    ),
    trailing_pe = dplyr::if_else(
      is.finite(trailing_pe),
      trailing_pe,
      NA_real_
    ),
    price_to_book = dplyr::if_else(
      is.finite(price_to_book),
      price_to_book,
      NA_real_
    ),
    operating_margin = NA_real_,
    benchmark_group = factor(
      dplyr::if_else(is_sp500, "S&P 500", "Broader Market"),
      levels = benchmark_levels
    )
  )

apply_equity_filters <- function(data) {
  current <- data
  log_rows <- list(
    tibble::tibble(
      step = "Unique Common Equity/ADR candidate symbols",
      starting_observations = nrow(current),
      removed_at_step = 0L,
      remaining_observations = nrow(current),
      removal_rate_from_previous = 0
    )
  )

  filter_steps <- list(
    list(
      label = "Require valid Yahoo quote or historical-price data",
      keep = function(x) x$valid_yahoo_data
    ),
    list(
      label = "Require positive market capitalization",
      keep = function(x) is.finite(x$market_cap) & x$market_cap > 0
    ),
    list(
      label = "Require positive reference price",
      keep = function(x) is.finite(x$reference_price) & x$reference_price > 0
    ),
    list(
      label = "Require populated standardized sector",
      keep = function(x) !is.na(x$sector_clean)
    ),
    list(
      label = "Require populated industry classification",
      keep = function(x) !is.na(x$industry_clean)
    )
  )

  for (step_index in seq_along(filter_steps)) {
    step <- filter_steps[[step_index]]
    starting_count <- nrow(current)
    keep_vector <- step$keep(current)
    keep_vector[is.na(keep_vector)] <- FALSE
    next_data <- current[keep_vector, , drop = FALSE]
    remaining_count <- nrow(next_data)
    removed_count <- starting_count - remaining_count

    log_rows[[length(log_rows) + 1L]] <- tibble::tibble(
      step = step$label,
      starting_observations = starting_count,
      removed_at_step = removed_count,
      remaining_observations = remaining_count,
      removal_rate_from_previous = safe_rate(
        removed_count,
        starting_count
      )
    )

    current <- next_data
  }

  list(
    data = current,
    log = dplyr::bind_rows(log_rows)
  )
}

post_retrieval_data_quality <- tibble::tibble(
  metric = c(
    "Unique download-candidate symbols",
    "Duplicate Yahoo-compatible symbol rate",
    "Valid Yahoo-data rate",
    "Missing positive market-capitalization rate",
    "Missing positive reference-price rate",
    "Missing standardized-sector rate",
    "Missing industry-classification rate",
    "S&P 500 candidate valid Yahoo-data rate"
  ),
  value = c(
    nrow(analysis_enriched_df),
    safe_rate(
      nrow(analysis_enriched_df) -
        dplyr::n_distinct(analysis_enriched_df$symbol_yahoo, na.rm = TRUE),
      nrow(analysis_enriched_df)
    ),
    safe_rate(
      sum(analysis_enriched_df$valid_yahoo_data, na.rm = TRUE),
      nrow(analysis_enriched_df)
    ),
    mean(
      !(is.finite(analysis_enriched_df$market_cap) &
          analysis_enriched_df$market_cap > 0)
    ),
    mean(
      !(is.finite(analysis_enriched_df$reference_price) &
          analysis_enriched_df$reference_price > 0)
    ),
    mean(is.na(analysis_enriched_df$sector_clean)),
    mean(is.na(analysis_enriched_df$industry_clean)),
    safe_rate(
      sum(
        analysis_enriched_df$is_sp500 &
          analysis_enriched_df$valid_yahoo_data,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      sum(analysis_enriched_df$is_sp500, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  ),
  display_value = c(
    format_count(nrow(analysis_enriched_df)),
    format_percent_1(
      safe_rate(
        nrow(analysis_enriched_df) -
          dplyr::n_distinct(
            analysis_enriched_df$symbol_yahoo,
            na.rm = TRUE
          ),
        nrow(analysis_enriched_df)
      )
    ),
    format_percent_1(
      safe_rate(
        sum(analysis_enriched_df$valid_yahoo_data, na.rm = TRUE),
        nrow(analysis_enriched_df)
      )
    ),
    format_percent_1(
      mean(
        !(is.finite(analysis_enriched_df$market_cap) &
            analysis_enriched_df$market_cap > 0)
      )
    ),
    format_percent_1(
      mean(
        !(is.finite(analysis_enriched_df$reference_price) &
            analysis_enriched_df$reference_price > 0)
      )
    ),
    format_percent_1(mean(is.na(analysis_enriched_df$sector_clean))),
    format_percent_1(mean(is.na(analysis_enriched_df$industry_clean))),
    format_percent_1(
      safe_rate(
        sum(
          analysis_enriched_df$is_sp500 &
            analysis_enriched_df$valid_yahoo_data,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        sum(analysis_enriched_df$is_sp500, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    )
  )
)

equity_filter_result <- apply_equity_filters(analysis_enriched_df)

equity_universe_df <- equity_filter_result$data |>
  dplyr::arrange(symbol_yahoo) |>
  dplyr::distinct(symbol_yahoo, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    benchmark_group = factor(benchmark_group, levels = benchmark_levels)
  )

equity_attrition_table <- equity_filter_result$log |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    removal_rate_display = format_percent_1(removal_rate_from_previous)
  )

final_universe_group_counts <- equity_universe_df |>
  dplyr::count(benchmark_group, name = "ticker_count", .drop = FALSE)

quote_log_file <- file.path(
  cache_directory,
  paste0("quote_log_", analysis_date, "_", download_symbol_hash, ".csv")
)
price_log_file <- file.path(
  cache_directory,
  paste0("price_log_", analysis_date, "_", download_symbol_hash, ".csv")
)

write_csv_safely <- function(data, path) {
  write_attempt <- capture_call(function() {
    readr::write_csv(data, path, na = "")
    invisible(path)
  })

  tibble::tibble(
    output_file = path,
    status = if (isTRUE(write_attempt$ok)) "written" else "write_failed",
    message = if (isTRUE(write_attempt$ok)) {
      if (length(write_attempt$warnings) == 0L) {
        NA_character_
      } else {
        paste(write_attempt$warnings, collapse = " | ")
      }
    } else {
      write_attempt$error
    }
  )
}

quote_log_write <- write_csv_safely(quote_log, quote_log_file)
price_log_write <- write_csv_safely(price_log, price_log_file)
```

# Module 2: Market capitalization and liquidity distributions

Market capitalization uses valid exchange-directory market capitalization first and a Yahoo quote value only as a fallback. Liquidity is the mean of unadjusted daily close multiplied by daily share volume over the most recent 30 valid trading observations. The metric is set to `NA` when fewer than `r minimum_valid_trading_days` valid observations are available.

```{r}
#| label: module2-summaries
#| results: asis

module2_coverage <- metric_coverage_table(
  equity_universe_df,
  metrics = c(
    "market_cap",
    "avg_daily_share_volume_30d",
    "avg_daily_dollar_volume_30d"
  ),
  labels = c(
    "Market capitalization",
    "30-day average daily share volume",
    "30-day average daily dollar volume"
  )
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    missingness_rate = format_percent_1(missingness_rate)
  )

module2_summary <- equity_universe_df |>
  dplyr::group_by(benchmark_group, .drop = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    ticker_count = dplyr::n(),
    valid_market_cap_count = sum(is.finite(market_cap)),
    median_market_cap = safe_median(market_cap),
    market_cap_p25 = safe_quantile(market_cap, 0.25),
    market_cap_p75 = safe_quantile(market_cap, 0.75),
    market_cap_missing_rate = mean(!is.finite(market_cap)),
    valid_liquidity_count = sum(is.finite(avg_daily_dollar_volume_30d)),
    median_share_volume_30d = safe_median(avg_daily_share_volume_30d),
    median_dollar_volume_30d = safe_median(avg_daily_dollar_volume_30d),
    share_volume_missing_rate = mean(!is.finite(avg_daily_share_volume_30d)),
    dollar_volume_missing_rate = mean(!is.finite(avg_daily_dollar_volume_30d)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

module2_summary_display <- module2_summary |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    benchmark_group,
    ticker_count = format_count(ticker_count),
    valid_market_cap_count = format_count(valid_market_cap_count),
    median_market_cap = format_dollar_short(median_market_cap),
    market_cap_p25 = format_dollar_short(market_cap_p25),
    market_cap_p75 = format_dollar_short(market_cap_p75),
    market_cap_missing_rate = format_percent_1(market_cap_missing_rate),
    valid_liquidity_count = format_count(valid_liquidity_count),
    median_share_volume_30d = format_number_short(median_share_volume_30d),
    median_dollar_volume_30d = format_dollar_short(median_dollar_volume_30d),
    share_volume_missing_rate = format_percent_1(share_volume_missing_rate),
    dollar_volume_missing_rate = format_percent_1(dollar_volume_missing_rate)
  )

show_table(module2_coverage, "Module 2 data coverage")
show_table(module2_summary_display, "Module 2 distribution summary by benchmark group")
```

# Module 3: Fundamental and profitability profiling

The snapshot quote route is used for trailing P/E and price-to-book. P/E plotting retains positive finite observations from 0 to 100. Price-to-book plotting retains positive finite observations from 0 to 20. Values outside these display bounds remain in the stored data and are counted below; the underlying fields are not winsorized.

```{r}
#| label: module3-summaries
#| results: asis

module3_summary <- equity_universe_df |>
  dplyr::group_by(benchmark_group, .drop = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    ticker_count = dplyr::n(),
    valid_pe_count = sum(is.finite(trailing_pe) & trailing_pe > 0),
    pe_coverage_rate = mean(is.finite(trailing_pe) & trailing_pe > 0),
    median_pe = safe_median(trailing_pe[is.finite(trailing_pe) & trailing_pe > 0]),
    pe_p25 = safe_quantile(
      trailing_pe[is.finite(trailing_pe) & trailing_pe > 0],
      0.25
    ),
    pe_p75 = safe_quantile(
      trailing_pe[is.finite(trailing_pe) & trailing_pe > 0],
      0.75
    ),
    pe_above_100 = sum(is.finite(trailing_pe) & trailing_pe > 100),
    valid_price_to_book_count = sum(
      is.finite(price_to_book) & price_to_book > 0
    ),
    price_to_book_coverage_rate = mean(
      is.finite(price_to_book) & price_to_book > 0
    ),
    median_price_to_book = safe_median(
      price_to_book[is.finite(price_to_book) & price_to_book > 0]
    ),
    price_to_book_p25 = safe_quantile(
      price_to_book[is.finite(price_to_book) & price_to_book > 0],
      0.25
    ),
    price_to_book_p75 = safe_quantile(
      price_to_book[is.finite(price_to_book) & price_to_book > 0],
      0.75
    ),
    price_to_book_above_20 = sum(
      is.finite(price_to_book) & price_to_book > 20
    ),
    operating_margin_coverage_rate = mean(is.finite(operating_margin)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

module3_summary_display <- module3_summary |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    benchmark_group,
    ticker_count = format_count(ticker_count),
    valid_pe_count = format_count(valid_pe_count),
    pe_coverage_rate = format_percent_1(pe_coverage_rate),
    median_pe = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(median_pe), "NA", scales::number(median_pe, accuracy = 0.1)
    ),
    pe_iqr = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(pe_p25) | is.na(pe_p75),
      "NA",
      paste0(
        scales::number(pe_p25, accuracy = 0.1),
        " to ",
        scales::number(pe_p75, accuracy = 0.1)
      )
    ),
    pe_above_100 = format_count(pe_above_100),
    valid_price_to_book_count = format_count(valid_price_to_book_count),
    price_to_book_coverage_rate = format_percent_1(
      price_to_book_coverage_rate
    ),
    median_price_to_book = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(median_price_to_book),
      "NA",
      scales::number(median_price_to_book, accuracy = 0.1)
    ),
    price_to_book_iqr = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(price_to_book_p25) | is.na(price_to_book_p75),
      "NA",
      paste0(
        scales::number(price_to_book_p25, accuracy = 0.1),
        " to ",
        scales::number(price_to_book_p75, accuracy = 0.1)
      )
    ),
    price_to_book_above_20 = format_count(price_to_book_above_20),
    operating_margin_coverage_rate = format_percent_1(
      operating_margin_coverage_rate
    )
  )

module3_coverage <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  tibble::tibble(
    metric = "Trailing P/E: positive finite observations",
    initial_observations = nrow(equity_universe_df),
    valid_observations = sum(
      is.finite(equity_universe_df$trailing_pe) &
        equity_universe_df$trailing_pe > 0
    ),
    missing_observations = sum(
      !(is.finite(equity_universe_df$trailing_pe) &
          equity_universe_df$trailing_pe > 0)
    ),
    missingness_rate = mean(
      !(is.finite(equity_universe_df$trailing_pe) &

      equity_universe_df$is_sp500 &
        is.finite(equity_universe_df$trailing_pe) &
        equity_universe_df$trailing_pe > 0
    ),
    broader_market_valid = sum(
      !equity_universe_df$is_sp500 &
        is.finite(equity_universe_df$trailing_pe) &
        equity_universe_df$trailing_pe > 0
    )
  ),
  tibble::tibble(
    metric = "Price-to-book: positive finite observations",
    initial_observations = nrow(equity_universe_df),
    valid_observations = sum(
      is.finite(equity_universe_df$price_to_book) &
        equity_universe_df$price_to_book > 0
    ),
    missing_observations = sum(
      !(is.finite(equity_universe_df$price_to_book) &
          equity_universe_df$price_to_book > 0)
    ),
    missingness_rate = mean(
      !(is.finite(equity_universe_df$price_to_book) &
          equity_universe_df$price_to_book > 0)
    ),
    sp500_valid = sum(
      equity_universe_df$is_sp500 &
        is.finite(equity_universe_df$price_to_book) &
        equity_universe_df$price_to_book > 0
    ),
    broader_market_valid = sum(
      !equity_universe_df$is_sp500 &
        is.finite(equity_universe_df$price_to_book) &
        equity_universe_df$price_to_book > 0
    )
  ),
  tibble::tibble(
    metric = "Operating margin",
    initial_observations = nrow(equity_universe_df),
    valid_observations = sum(is.finite(equity_universe_df$operating_margin)),
    missing_observations = sum(!is.finite(equity_universe_df$operating_margin)),

      equity_universe_df$is_sp500 &

    ),

) |>
```

# Module 4: Sector concentration and skew

For this module, the **broad equity universe** means the complete final operating-company equity universe, including current S&P 500 constituents. Ticker-count share is the equal-weighted listing-breadth view. Market-cap share weights that same broad universe by valid market capitalization. S&P 500 weights come directly from the current constituent table and are re-normalized over positive constituent weights.

```{r}
#| label: module4-calculations

sp500_positive_weight_total <- sum(
  sp500_df$sp500_weight[
    is.finite(sp500_df$sp500_weight) &
      sp500_df$sp500_weight > 0
  ],
  na.rm = TRUE
)

sp500_missing_sector_weight <- sum(
  sp500_df$sp500_weight[
    is.finite(sp500_df$sp500_weight) &
      sp500_df$sp500_weight > 0 &
      is.na(sp500_df$sp500_sector_clean)
  ],
  na.rm = TRUE
)

sp500_sector_weights <- sp500_df |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(sp500_sector_clean),
    is.finite(sp500_weight),
    sp500_weight > 0
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(sector = sp500_sector_clean) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    sp500_weight_pct = sum(sp500_weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sp500_sector_weight_sum <- sum(
  sp500_sector_weights$sp500_weight_pct,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

if (sp500_sector_weight_sum > 0) {
  sp500_sector_weights <- sp500_sector_weights |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      sp500_weight_pct = sp500_weight_pct / sp500_sector_weight_sum
    )
}

broader_market_sector_base <- equity_universe_df

broader_market_total_count <- nrow(broader_market_sector_base)
broader_market_classified_count <- sum(
  !is.na(broader_market_sector_base$sector_clean)
)
broader_market_missing_sector_count <- sum(
  is.na(broader_market_sector_base$sector_clean)
)

broader_market_total_cap <- sum(
  broader_market_sector_base$market_cap[
    is.finite(broader_market_sector_base$market_cap) &
      broader_market_sector_base$market_cap > 0
  ],
  na.rm = TRUE
)

broader_market_missing_sector_cap <- sum(
  broader_market_sector_base$market_cap[
    is.finite(broader_market_sector_base$market_cap) &
      broader_market_sector_base$market_cap > 0 &
      is.na(broader_market_sector_base$sector_clean)
  ],
  na.rm = TRUE
)

broader_sector_counts <- broader_market_sector_base |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(sector_clean)) |>
  dplyr::count(sector = sector_clean, name = "ticker_count")

if (broader_market_classified_count > 0L) {
  broader_sector_counts <- broader_sector_counts |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      broad_ticker_count_pct = ticker_count / broader_market_classified_count
    )
} else {
  broader_sector_counts <- broader_sector_counts |>
    dplyr::mutate(broad_ticker_count_pct = NA_real_)
}

broader_sector_market_cap <- broader_market_sector_base |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(sector_clean),
    is.finite(market_cap),
    market_cap > 0
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(sector = sector_clean) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    sector_market_cap = sum(market_cap, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

classified_broader_market_cap <- sum(
  broader_sector_market_cap$sector_market_cap,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

if (classified_broader_market_cap > 0) {
  broader_sector_market_cap <- broader_sector_market_cap |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      broad_market_cap_pct = sector_market_cap / classified_broader_market_cap
    )
} else {
  broader_sector_market_cap <- broader_sector_market_cap |>
    dplyr::mutate(broad_market_cap_pct = NA_real_)
}

sector_comparison_table <- sp500_sector_weights |>
  dplyr::full_join(
    broader_sector_counts |>
      dplyr::select(sector, broad_ticker_count_pct),
    by = "sector"
  ) |>
  dplyr::full_join(
    broader_sector_market_cap |>
      dplyr::select(sector, broad_market_cap_pct),
    by = "sector"
  )

if (sp500_sector_weight_sum > 0) {
  sector_comparison_table$sp500_weight_pct <- tidyr::replace_na(
    sector_comparison_table$sp500_weight_pct,
    0
  )
}
if (broader_market_classified_count > 0L) {
  sector_comparison_table$broad_ticker_count_pct <- tidyr::replace_na(
    sector_comparison_table$broad_ticker_count_pct,
    0
  )
}
if (classified_broader_market_cap > 0) {
  sector_comparison_table$broad_market_cap_pct <- tidyr::replace_na(
    sector_comparison_table$broad_market_cap_pct,
    0
  )
}

sector_comparison_table <- sector_comparison_table |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    sp500_minus_broad_market_cap =
      sp500_weight_pct - broad_market_cap_pct,
    sp500_minus_broad_ticker_count =
      sp500_weight_pct - broad_ticker_count_pct
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(sp500_weight_pct),
    dplyr::desc(broad_market_cap_pct)
  )

module4_metric_coverage <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  tibble::tibble(
    metric = "Standardized sector classification",
    initial_observations = nrow(equity_universe_df),
    valid_observations = sum(!is.na(equity_universe_df$sector_clean)),
    missing_observations = sum(is.na(equity_universe_df$sector_clean)),
    missingness_rate = mean(is.na(equity_universe_df$sector_clean)),
    sp500_valid = sum(
      equity_universe_df$is_sp500 & !is.na(equity_universe_df$sector_clean)
    ),
    broader_market_valid = sum(
      !equity_universe_df$is_sp500 & !is.na(equity_universe_df$sector_clean)
    )
  ),
  tibble::tibble(
    metric = "Positive market capitalization",
    initial_observations = nrow(equity_universe_df),
    valid_observations = sum(
      is.finite(equity_universe_df$market_cap) &
        equity_universe_df$market_cap > 0
    ),
    missing_observations = sum(
      !(is.finite(equity_universe_df$market_cap) &
          equity_universe_df$market_cap > 0)
    ),
    missingness_rate = mean(
      !(is.finite(equity_universe_df$market_cap) &
          equity_universe_df$market_cap > 0)
    ),
    sp500_valid = sum(
      equity_universe_df$is_sp500 &
        is.finite(equity_universe_df$market_cap) &
        equity_universe_df$market_cap > 0
    ),
    broader_market_valid = sum(
      !equity_universe_df$is_sp500 &
        is.finite(equity_universe_df$market_cap) &
        equity_universe_df$market_cap > 0
    )
  )
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(missingness_rate = format_percent_1(missingness_rate))

sector_coverage_table <- tibble::tibble(
  measure = c(
    "S&P 500 positive constituent weight represented by classified sectors",
    "S&P 500 weight omitted for missing sector",
    "Broad-universe ticker records represented by classified sectors",
    "Broad-universe ticker records omitted for missing sector",
    "Broad-universe market capitalization represented by classified sectors",
    "Broad-universe market capitalization omitted for missing sector"
  ),
  value = c(
    sp500_sector_weight_sum,
    sp500_missing_sector_weight,
    broader_market_classified_count,
    broader_market_missing_sector_count,
    classified_broader_market_cap,
    broader_market_missing_sector_cap
  ),
  display_value = c(
    format_percent_1(sp500_sector_weight_sum),
    format_percent_1(sp500_missing_sector_weight),
    format_count(broader_market_classified_count),
    paste0(
      format_count(broader_market_missing_sector_count),
      " (",
      format_percent_1(
        safe_rate(
          broader_market_missing_sector_count,
          broader_market_total_count
        )
      ),
      ")"
    ),
    format_dollar_short(classified_broader_market_cap),
    paste0(
      format_dollar_short(broader_market_missing_sector_cap),
      " (",
      format_percent_1(
        safe_rate(
          broader_market_missing_sector_cap,
          broader_market_total_cap
        )
      ),
      ")"
    )
  )
)

sector_comparison_display <- sector_comparison_table |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    sector,
    sp500_weight_pct = format_percent_1(sp500_weight_pct),
    broad_ticker_count_pct = format_percent_1(broad_ticker_count_pct),
    broad_market_cap_pct = format_percent_1(broad_market_cap_pct),
    sp500_minus_broad_market_cap = format_percent_1(
      sp500_minus_broad_market_cap
    ),
    sp500_minus_broad_ticker_count = format_percent_1(
      sp500_minus_broad_ticker_count
    )
  )
```

# Consolidated data coverage

```{r}
#| label: consolidated-missingness

missingness_row <- function(scope, data, variable, missing_condition = NULL) {
  if (!is.data.frame(data)) {
    return(tibble::tibble())
  }

  total <- nrow(data)

  if (is.null(missing_condition)) {
    values <- data[[variable]]
    missing <- is.na(values)
  } else {
    missing <- missing_condition(data)
    missing[is.na(missing)] <- TRUE
  }

  tibble::tibble(
    scope = scope,
    variable = variable,
    total_observations = total,
    missing_observations = sum(missing),
    valid_observations = total - sum(missing),
    missingness_rate = safe_rate(sum(missing), total)
  )
}

consolidated_missingness <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  missingness_row("Full listed-security universe", universe_df, "exchange"),
  missingness_row("Full listed-security universe", universe_df, "security_type"),
  missingness_row(
    "Download-candidate equity universe",
    analysis_enriched_df,
    "market_cap",
    function(x) !is.finite(x$market_cap) | x$market_cap <= 0
  ),
  missingness_row(
    "Download-candidate equity universe",
    analysis_enriched_df,
    "sector_clean"
  ),
  missingness_row(
    "Download-candidate equity universe",
    analysis_enriched_df,
    "industry_clean"
  ),
  missingness_row(
    "Download-candidate equity universe",
    analysis_enriched_df,
    "historical_price_data",
    function(x) !x$historical_data_available
  ),
  missingness_row(
    "Download-candidate equity universe",
    analysis_enriched_df,
    "avg_daily_share_volume_30d",
    function(x) !is.finite(x$avg_daily_share_volume_30d)
  ),
  missingness_row(
    "Download-candidate equity universe",
    analysis_enriched_df,
    "avg_daily_dollar_volume_30d",
    function(x) !is.finite(x$avg_daily_dollar_volume_30d)
  ),
  missingness_row(
    "Final operating-company equity universe",
    equity_universe_df,
    "trailing_pe",
    function(x) !is.finite(x$trailing_pe)
  ),
  missingness_row(
    "Final operating-company equity universe",
    equity_universe_df,
    "price_to_book",
    function(x) !is.finite(x$price_to_book)
  ),
  missingness_row(
```
